name: kiaaccess-mcp
description: Kia Access vehicle tools — status, location, doors, climate, and charging
long_description: Talks to the Kia Owners API the Kia Access mobile app uses, authenticating with your own Kia account email and password. Read tools cover the vehicle list, cached and force-refreshed status, location, odometer, and EV charge state. Every command that acts on the vehicle — door lock/unlock, climate start/stop, charge start/stop, charge limits — is confirm-gated: without an explicit confirm it makes no network call and returns a dry-run preview of exactly what would be sent.

kia_username.title: Kia account email
kia_username.description: The email address you sign in to Kia Access / the Kia Owners Portal with.

kia_password.title: Kia account password
kia_password.description: Your Kia account password. Stored by the host, sent only to Kia's login endpoint.

kia_write_mode.title: Vehicle command mode
kia_write_mode.description: "none" disables all vehicle commands; "comfort" allows climate and charging; "all" also allows door lock/unlock.
